sentences.text:
Author: D. Dash
Bench: D. Dash
 Ablapl No. 16213 Of 2020
03. 08.02.2021 The matter is taken up through video conferencing
 mode.
 The Petitioner having been implicated in Jagatpur P.S.
 Case No.494 of 2020 corresponding to G.R. Case No.2675 of
 2020 on the file of learned J.M.F.C.(R), Cuttack for alleged
 commission of offence under section 420/272/273/34 of the
 Ipc read with section-51/52/56/57/59 of the Food Safety &
 Standards Act, 2006 (hereinafter called "the Fss Act) and
section 16 of the Prevention of Food Adulteration Act, 1954,
 has filed this application under section 438 of the Cr.P.C. for
 his release on bail in the event of his arrest in the said case.

Learned counsel for the Petitioner submits that the  Petitioner is having his Food Processing Unit at Jagatpur and  for preparing Pan Masala under the trade name, M/s. Khusboo  Products, there has been due registration and license to that  effect having been taken; is being renewed from time to time  and so also trade mark certificate has also been obtained.
It is  his submission that the 'Pan Masala' and 'Chemicals' kept for  use from the being seized from Unit of the Petitioner, samples  collected therefrom have in the meantime been analyzed by the
. He submits  that as per the report, all the suspected food additives have  been found to permit as also 'Katha' and the final product have

been found to be in conformity with the standards as prescribed  // 2 //
keeping in view the safety as to human consumption
. In view of all these above, when there remains no such other impediment; he urges for grant of anticipatory bail to the Petitioner.

Learned counsel for the State placing the case diary as also the three reports of the Deputy Director-cum-Food Analyst submits that the three chemical samples sent for analysis have been reported to be permitted additives; the sample of Katha seized has been found out in conformity with the standard prescribed under the FSS Act.

He however submits that the sample packets of the Pan Masala although ABLAPL/16213/2020 on 8 February, 2021 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/158093475/
1 have been found to be in conformity with the standard prescribed in the Act in so far as the results under the different tests are concerned; irregularities if any as to compliance of FSS (FP & FA) Regulations are likely to be known in course of further investigation.
 Considering the submissions and on going through the nature of accusations

; further keeping in view the surrounding circumstances of the case as also concerning the Petitioner as also the role said to have been played by the Petitioner in the incident and in the absence of any other impediment, it is directed that in the event of arrest of the Petitioner in the above mentioned case, he shall be released on bail on such terms and conditions as would be deemed just and proper by the  // 3 //
 Arresting Officer with further conditions that he will appear  before the Investigating Officer as and when so required for  the purpose of investigation.
The ABLAPL is accordingly disposed of.

..........................
 D. Dash, J.
Narayan ABLAPL/16213/2020 on 8 February, 2021 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/158093475/
2
